claims.statement: PositionPipeline.loadPortfolio turns a wallet address into a PortfolioResult through five ordered steps: an on-chain scan via DLMM.getAllLbPairPositionsByUser, batched token-price fetch for the union of mints, per-pool best-effort PnL fetch, resolution of one ResolvedPosition per lbPairPositionsData entry via the pure computePositionViewData (PnL matched with findPositionPnL, null when absent), and aggregation into a PortfolioSummaryData plus outOfRangeCount. Position count can exceed pool count because one pair holds many positions.

loadPortfolio short-circuits an empty wallet (no positions) to an empty result with summary null and hasPnLData false, and the convenience method fetchPortfolioSummary returns a widget-friendly subset of the summary fields — or null when the wallet has no positions.

Token prices are best-effort: TokenService.getPrices batch-fetches mints with Promise.allSettled and omits failed mints, the pipeline maps missing entries to null TokenInfo, and computePositionViewData degrades to $0.00 values, "-" fee displays, and a null liquidityShape — positions still render when token prices fail.

PnL is fetched best-effort per pool: fetchAllPnL wraps each pool's fetch in Promise.allSettled with its own try/catch, so one failing pool neither blocks the others nor rejects the pipeline; fetchPortfolioSummary still returns partial data (e.g. correct positionCount) with numbers from only the pools that succeeded.

computeSummary returns summary null and hasPnLData false when no pool produced PnL rows (all fetches failed); the positions array is unaffected — every position returns with vm.pnlSol = null and vm.pnlSolPctChange = null — and a later successful retry flips hasPnLData back to true because the failed fetch was never cached.

computePoolPnLSummary defines totalInitialDepositSol per position as gross deposits minus gross withdrawals (principal RemoveLiquidity events; claimed fees live separately under allTimeFees so they are not double-subtracted). Gross deposits alone double-count redeposits after a withdrawal (deposit 4.5, withdraw, redeposit 4.5 reads 9.0 instead of the real 4.5 basis). When no deposit SOL data exists at all, the basis falls back to value − uPnL (posValueSol - posPnlSol).

In the portfolio summary, totalPnlPercent is the |net cost basis|-weighted mean of per-position pnlSolPctChange (positions with a non-positive basis contribute no weight), and feesTvl24h is the position-value-weighted mean of parseFeePerTvl24h ratios, null when no position has both a ratio and positive value.

Per-position value in the aggregation comes from unrealizedPnl.balancesSol; when the server provides no SOL figure it falls back to unrealizedPnl.balances / 200 — the raw balance divided by an assumed SOL price of ~200 USD.

vm.pnlSol and vm.pnlSolPctChange (and the same fields on the PositionPnLData wire type) hold uPnL — unrealized PnL, current value minus initial deposit — despite the name; this is an inherited upstream naming convention recorded in UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md, and display always renders it as uPnL.

The pipeline is testable without RPC through three PipelineDeps seams: cache (defaults to the CacheManager singleton; tests inject CacheManager.createFresh, a private-constructor instance made for tests), connection (resolved lazily via getSharedConnection only when the chain is actually scanned, so construction never requires an RPC URL), and dataServices (defaults to createDataServices(cache); fakes can be injected).

Per-pool PnL is cached under the key pnl:{poolAddress}:{walletAddress} with TTL CACHE_TTL.UPNL_PER_POSITION (15 minutes) through CacheManager.getOrFetch, and the fetch requests only status: 'open' positions from the DLMM Data API.

fetchAllPositionPnL walks PnL pages (50 per page, max 10) and rejects without returning partial data if pagination fails or exceeds the page cap; because only fulfilled fetches reach the cache, a mid-pagination failure leaves no cache entry and the next loadPortfolio retries the pool cleanly.

invalidateWallet calls cache.invalidatePattern(":{walletAddress}"), which matches only keys containing the wallet suffix — the PnL keys — so token_data: entries and other wallets' PnL data survive; usePositionsPage invokes it on wallet switch and before every refresh.

Two summary paths exist deliberately: the in-app summary is client-aggregated via computePoolPnLSummary (position-value-weighted, net cost basis), while the PortfolioSummary Android widget bypasses the pipeline entirely and reads server totals from dlmmApi.fetchOpenPortfolioSummary (ADR 0002), deriving its deposited figure as value − uPnL; PositionPipeline.fetchPortfolioSummary predates ADR 0002 and is no longer the widget's data path.

The owned dlmmApi transport raises DlmmApiError on network failure (status null) or non-OK HTTP (with status) — no silent nulls — and keeps money values as strings on its wire types (with legacy variance such as pnlSol?: string | number | null tolerated); consumers, not the transport, convert them to numbers.

fetchOpenPortfolioSummary walks every /portfolio/open page and rolls up the two fields the server does not aggregate — outOfRangeCount (Σ positionsOutOfRange.length) and a pool-value-weighted 24h fees/TVL ratio — while deliberately not rolling up per-pool totalDepositSol because that figure is gross and double-counts redeposits after a withdrawal.

parseFeePerTvl24h converts the DLMM API's feePerTvl24h percentage ("1.31" = 1.31% daily) into the internal ratio representation (0.0131), returning null for missing, non-finite, or negative values; the view model and both summaries store the ratio so display multiplies by 100.

computePositionViewData is a pure function (no store access, no side effects) mapping positionData + activeId + token infos + PnLData to a PositionViewModel; its parsePnlNumber normalizes string-or-number wire values to finite numbers and returns null for missing, blank, or non-finite input, so an unavailable PnL value never becomes zero. Missing positionData or tokens yield $0.00 / "-" / null liquidityShape defaults.

Three consumers run the pipeline: usePositionsPage (loadPortfolio on wallet change, refresh throttled to one call per 30 s, silent auto-refresh every 60 s while foregrounded), syncPositionWidgets (loadPortfolio raced against a 20 s timeout, persisted as an MMKV PositionWidgetData snapshot), and the expo-background-fetch task widgetBackgroundSync (≥30 min interval) which reuses a pipeline result to detect out-of-range transitions from vm.inRange and send notifications.

Dev mock mode (env.devMock, forced on for the web target) bypasses the pipeline entirely: usePositionsPage returns a static portfolio from src/services/mockPortfolio.ts shaped exactly like a real PortfolioResult, so the positions UI renders without a wallet, RPC, or on-chain access.

Per ADR 0001 every monetary value in the pipeline derives from live-spot token prices (TokenInfo.price_info.price_per_token, SOL priced via the wrapped-SOL mint); the app does not fetch historical prices locally for PnL or value computation, and the OHLCV service in DataServices is display-only and must never feed PnL or value logic.
